hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | { read -r cmd; case "$cmd" in "git commit"*) out=$(go vet ./... 2>&1 && golangci-lint run 2>&1 && go test ./... 2>&1) || jq -n --arg reason "Pre-commit CI checks failed. Run manually to see details: go vet ./... && golangci-lint run && go test ./..." '{"continue":false,"stopReason":$reason}' ;; esac; }
